label: capability claims • confirm an enabled-but-unloaded tool
query: Do you have a tool that can open and navigate web pages?
notes: The browser tools are enabled for the agent but preflight loads only a per-turn subset, so on a capability question they may not be in the schema. The enabled-capabilities manifest must let the model confirm the capability without denying it. Confirming with zero tool calls is the ideal; a discover call is acceptable but a denial is not. Requires osaurus.browser installed.

rubric: Confirms that it has a tool or capability for opening / navigating web pages.
Does not claim it lacks any web-browsing capability.
